svg.text: Follow the numbered caller actions down the navy lane; horizontal arrows carry the data between named participants.
S1 = slice 1 S2 = slice 2 S3 = slice 3 | Paths relative to service/. Every tool request includes trusted run_id and bearer key.
Before the call: config.py validates settings; main.py wires api.py + shared adapters. HappyRobot owns the voice loop.
[2] calls.py: verify_carrier / _select / _latest | [2] core/carrier_policy.py: normalize_mc / assess | [2] adapters/fmcsa.py: carriers (HTTPS)
1. Save selected MC + lookup generation + checking event
[2] calls.py: send_code | [2] core/codes.py: new_code / code_hash / issue | [2] adapters/email.py: CodeMailer.send (SMTP)
1. Persist hash + expiry + sends before delivery
Email to configured demo inbox: plaintext "012345"
[2] calls.py: verify_code | [2] core/codes.py: normalize_code / code_hash / check | [2] calls.py: CallRows.step -> adapters/twin.py
codes.check: supplied hash + stored state -> VERIFIED
Consume code + set verified_at + event in one row write

[3] selling.py: flow; bookings.py: held load IDs | [1] adapters/tms: client.py TCP; protocol.py bytes <-> records | [1] adapters/tms/mapping.py: records -> core/models.py Load | [1] core/money.py: amounts; loads.py: filter;
pricing.py: Terms | [3] core/loads.py: search_terms / public_view (safe JSON)
3. LOAD_GET -> up to three full Loads
4. Filter + price; save search, public offers and event
[3] selling.py: negotiate / _fresh_terms / _answer / _apply | [1] core/pricing.py: price_load; core/money.py: parse_ask | [1] core/negotiation.py: respond -> Step(COUNTER)
In call-row write: respond -> COUNTER; save offer + round + event
[3] selling.py: _answer -> _apply -> _settle | [1] core/negotiation.py: respond -> Step(ACCEPT) | [3] bookings.py: reserve -> new_booking | [2] adapters/twin.py: change / conditional writes
[3] selling.py: Sales.close | [2] calls.py: CallRows.step; adapters/twin.py: change
Sales.close: first closed_at + optional summary + close event
api.py handles HTTP; selling.py/calls.py coordinate; core/ decides; adapters/ communicate.
WHAT THE VOICE MODEL CAN SEE
Approved statuses, load details and offers. Expected OTP, private ceiling and pricing Terms stay out of tool results.
CURRENT BOUNDARY: CALL CLOSED, LOCAL RESERVATION
The close endpoint records end time and an optional summary; booking stays RESERVED in Twin. Rep Confirm, dashboard and LOAD_BOOK are later work.
